title: Customer escalation war-room - Solaris Insurance (2026-03-22) - prep & actions
body:
Purpose:
- Prep notes for war-room with Solaris Insurance. Goal: stabilize production traffic, confirm root cause or mitigation, and agree on customer-facing timeline + actions.

Context / quick summary (TL;DR):
- Incident began 2026-03-21 18:40 PDT: increased 5xxs and elevated tail latency for their high-throughput dedicated cluster (dedicated-solaris-1).
- Customer reports ~25% of inference requests returning errors or timing out. Business impact: claims processing delays, SLA errors on throughput/availability.
- Initial triage indicates memory pressure on GPU hosts, local OOMs in runtime, and some KV cache corruption symptoms for long-running sessions.

Known facts / signals to check (logs & dashboards):
- Redwood Console: per-route error rate spike starting 2026-03-21 18:40 (route: /api/v1/generate/solaris-claims).
- Node logs (dedicated-solaris-1-*) show repeated "Alloc failed" + "kvcache checksum mismatch" on several hosts.
- Cloud provider autoscaler did not add new nodes due to quota error (quota exhausted in region us-west2). Jira ticket RED-4821 created for capacity/quota.
- Customer repro: sending long multi-step sessions with large prompt prefixes + heavy streaming. Sequence length distribution shifted higher than usual.

Immediate goals for this war-room (30-60m):
1) Confirm mitigation path to reduce customer impact within 1 hour (workarounds: route to fallback model variant, reduce batch sizes, enable aggressive cache eviction).
2) Surface root cause hypotheses and necessary infra fixes (OOMs vs. KV cache bug vs. autoscaler failure).
3) Agree on timeline for customer update and on-call rotations for 24h monitoring.

Agenda (start with a 5m recap):
- 0-5m: TL;DR and objective (Maya)
- 5-15m: Customer impact and timeline (Priya)
- 15-30m: Engineering triage: logs, metrics, host state (Ethan, Liam)
- 30-45m: Decide mitigation + immediate actions (all)
- 45-60m: Assign action items, comms plan, follow-ups

Investigation checklist / commands to run (notes to self):
- Check host OOM logs: sudo journalctl -u runtime -n 500 on ded-solaris-1-*
- Dump KV cache checksums and compare: /opt/redwood/bin/kvcache-check --dump --host <host>
- Query Console tracing for a failing request id: search request_id: "solar-err-<example>"
- Inspect autoscaler events: kubectl get hpa, and cloud provider quota alarms in billing console.
- Look at model variant config: prompt max length, kv cache retention, quantization profile used.

Mitigation options (fast -> slower):
- Immediate (5-15m): Route Solaris traffic to fallback small-compiler variant (solaris-claims-v1-fallback) with lower memory footprint.
- Near-term (15-60m): Reduce per-route max_batch_tokens and enforce aggressive cache TTL for their tenant.
- If autoscaler quota is root cause: request quota increase or temporarily move some workloads to another region (requires customer consent).
- Code fix (if kv cache bug): requires patch + canary deploy (ETA 1-2 days).

Customer comms (draft):
- Initial update within 30m: "We are actively investigating elevated errors with your dedicated cluster. We've identified memory pressure on some hosts and are executing an immediate mitigation to reduce errors while we continue root cause analysis. Will follow up in 1 hour with an update."
- Follow-up after mitigation: summary of mitigation, ETA for full resolution or next steps. (Priya to send / coordinate with CSM).

Action items (explicit; owner - due):
- Ethan: run KV cache checksum dumps on hosts ded-solaris-1-[a,b,c] and paste results to the Jira ticket. Due 2026-03-22 16:15 PDT.
- Liam: validate autoscaler events and cloud quota state; if quota blocked, open cloud ticket + escalate. Paste cloud ticket id to linked_artifacts. Due 2026-03-22 16:05 PDT.
- Priya: draft and send initial customer update (30m). Coordinate wording with Maya. Due 2026-03-22 15:55 PDT.
- Maya: flip routing to fallback variant (manual route override) and monitor error rate for 30m. Rollback plan if error increases. Due 2026-03-22 16:00 PDT.
- All: add any failing request ids + traces to RED-4821. Ongoing.

Post-meeting follow-up (notes):
- If fallback reduces errors to <2% within 30m, we keep for 24h while engineering completes root cause.
- If errors persist, consider pausing heavy streaming sessions for the tenant and move to scheduled batch processing.
- Prepare post-incident postmortem draft and timeline for stakeholder review (target: 2026-03-24).

Open questions / TBD (to capture during meeting):
- Is KV cache checksum mismatch a symptom or root cause? (need memory heap dumps)
- Was there a recent model/weight change or config push for Solaris that increased memory usage? (check deployment history)
- Are there any correlated incidents in other tenants (possible regression affecting shared runtime)?

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep comms concise and set expectations (we can stabilize quickly but root cause may take longer).
- Save all traces/log snippets in RED-4821 for postmortem.
- After meeting: schedule 1:1 with infra lead for quota process improvement (longer term).

Next sync: 2026-03-22 16:30 PDT (tentative) - 30m follow-up update.

-- Maya
